attributes.action: Amend PACE Code C to include mandatory neurodivergent training for all police.
attributes.additional_details: Many Neurodivergent people are frequently receiving legal sanctions, convictions and unnecessary, completely avoidable trauma as a result. These things can significantly have a devastating impact on their lives. This is due to police misunderstanding the condition, intent and communication differences / barriers. A criminal / police record can affect their employment chances and can unnecessarily make them appear as a higher risk on risk assessments.
attributes.background: We ask the home office to make amendments to PACE Code C, making it mandatory for all police and custody staff to receive neurodiversity training and ensure there is a specialist Appropriate Adult service for neurodivergents taken into custody.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this open petition which calls for similar action:

'Neurodiversity: Fund police training, review of police custody & data collection'
